description: Usage of the month for the free tier display (docs/plans/FREE-TIER-LIZENZ.md, L-1/L-3): onesimus.fn_usage_month(p_month) sums JobBytes of backup jobs (Type B) without VirtualFull (Level f), by StartTime in the session time zone, regardless of the final status; one source for odir (status dir, GetDirectorStatus.usage) and the GUI. held_jobs stays 0 until the free tier holds jobs (table job_skip, later step).
author: Onesimus

functions.name: onesimus.fn_usage_month
functions.description: Bytes written by backup jobs (Type B, Level not f = VirtualFull) started in the calendar month of p_month (session time zone), number of such jobs and of jobs held by the free tier limit (0 until job_skip exists). Late-bound SQL body (string): no dependency on Bareos tables recorded.
functions.returns: TABLE(month date, bytes_written numeric, jobs bigint, held_jobs bigint)
functions.body: SELECT date_trunc('month', p_month)::date, COALESCE(sum(j.jobbytes), 0)::numeric, count(j.jobid)::bigint, 0::bigint FROM public.job j WHERE j.type = 'B' AND j.level <> 'f' AND j.starttime >= date_trunc('month', p_month) AND j.starttime < date_trunc('month', p_month) + interval '1 month'
